request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:RAIDER

layers.text: Recolour only the rider's skin: his face, his two big pointed ears, his arms and hands become bright lime green, colour #86c232, with lighter #acdc55 on the face and #5a9424 as shading; no yellow skin and no orange ears. Keep everything else exactly the same: the grey wolf with its cream belly and muzzle, the sand hat, straps, saddle blanket, spear, pose, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
